Property Assessments & Records

The Ada County Assessor’s office’s staff manages a vast database of property records.  Our office is responsible for the annual valuation of all real and personal property parcels for property tax purposes, and maintains records of property ownership, parcel boundaries, and reviews all addressing and street naming applications in the county.
